concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-control-panel-security-rotating-api-keys]] - exposure-driven API-key rotation, overlapping old/new key validity, per-user Control Panel generation and confirmation-before-deletion safety boundary, kept distinct from login and payment authentication
warnings: Keep API credential rotation distinct from Control Panel login credentials, two-factor authentication, 3D Secure, payment authentication and transaction fraud screening.
Do not describe new-key generation as automatic revocation; the page says old keys continue working until they are deleted.
Preserve the required order: update code, confirm the new keys work and only then delete the old keys.
Do not infer a Control Panel role or permission requirement from this page; it states that the new key set is for the user but does not define role eligibility.
